core_responsibilities: This directory contains configuration files for the chatbot's frontend, including build tools (Vite) and end-to-end testing frameworks (Playwright).
This directory contains the main entry point and core components for the chatbot's user interface, including styling and application rendering logic.
This directory contains reusable UI components for the chatbot's frontend, specifically related to managing server connections (McpHub) and displaying workflow information (TransparentWorkflow).
This directory contains helper functions for testing the chatbot's frontend, providing utilities for waiting for various events, interacting with elements, and navigating the UI.
This directory contains end-to-end tests for the chatbot's frontend, verifying core functionalities like application loading, project management, workflow execution, and API integration.
This directory contains the core layout component for the Jato UI, defining the overall structure and arrangement of elements within the chatbot's frontend.
This directory contains implementations of various providers, including a factory for creating them and a specific provider for handling relationships, all within the ticket-to-code system.
This directory defines the API endpoints for interacting with the ticket-to-code workflow, handling requests for ticket submission, run creation, status updates, and report generation.
This directory contains logic for generating and storing a 'brain' representation of a software repository, likely for code analysis or understanding purposes.
This directory manages the state and lifecycle of ticket-related conversations, including session initialization and reasoning snapshots.
This directory contains initialization code for data-related modules within the ticket-to-code system.
This directory contains logic for validating delivery configurations and managing patch gates, ensuring code is delivered according to defined rules.
This directory enforces policies related to code integrity, manages structural manifests, and handles workspace integrity checks, including authorization for deletions and conflict resolution.

This directory defines the scope and language-specific contexts for intelligence-driven code generation, enabling the system to understand and operate within different programming language environments.
